# The shapes a credential actually arrives in: a log line, a body of JSON, a
# command line, a file of environment variables. What is redacted must not
# depend on the punctuation around it, and the text around it must come through
# byte for byte.
#
# This file is also where the cases saying what this library does not redact
# are written. A credential of a kind no pattern here knows is not masked, and
# stating that is what keeps the scope of the built-in patterns readable rather
# than assumed. A credential of a kind a pattern here does know is not located
# either where it reaches the text in an encoding of its own.

patterns: default

case:     a structured log line
in:       time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" token=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz status=200
out:      time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" token=«github-token» status=200

case:     a line of json
in:       {"level":"info","token":"ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz","jwt":"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef"}
out:      {"level":"info","token":"«github-token»","jwt":"«jwt»"}

case:     json with the credential nested
in:       {"auth":{"github":{"token":"ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"}}}
out:      {"auth":{"github":{"token":"«github-token»"}}}

case:     a file of environment variables
in:       HOME=/root\nGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\nPATH=/usr/bin
out:      HOME=/root\nGITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»\nPATH=/usr/bin

case:     a shared credentials file
in:       [default]\naws_access_key_id = AKIA0123456789ABCDEF\nregion = us-east-1
out:      [default]\naws_access_key_id = «aws-access-key-id»\nregion = us-east-1

case:     several credentials over several lines
in:       github: ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\njwt: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef\nnothing: here
out:      github: «github-token»\njwt: «jwt»\nnothing: here

case:     a curl command
in:       curl -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef" https://api.example.com/v1/user
out:      curl -H "Authorization: Bearer «jwt»" https://api.example.com/v1/user

case:     a docker run command
in:       docker run -e GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -it ubuntu:24.04 bash
out:      docker run -e GITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token» -it ubuntu:24.04 bash

case:     a git remote url
in:       origin\thttps://x-access-token:ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz@github.com/koki-develop/mask-go.git (fetch)
out:      origin\thttps://x-access-token:«github-token»@github.com/koki-develop/mask-go.git (fetch)

case:     a fragment of yaml
in:       env:\n  - name: GITHUB_TOKEN\n    value: ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:      env:\n  - name: GITHUB_TOKEN\n    value: «github-token»

case:     a fragment of toml
in:       [auth]\ntoken = "ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
out:      [auth]\ntoken = "«github-token»"

case:     a row of csv
in:       alice,admin,ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz,2026-08-17
out:      alice,admin,«github-token»,2026-08-17

case:     a query string
in:       /callback?code=abc&id_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef&state=xyz
out:      /callback?code=abc&id_token=«jwt»&state=xyz

case:     an http request dump
in:       GET /user HTTP/1.1\nHost: api.github.com\nAuthorization: Bearer ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\nAccept: application/json
out:      GET /user HTTP/1.1\nHost: api.github.com\nAuthorization: Bearer «github-token»\nAccept: application/json

case:     a line of an error message
in:       request failed: POST https://api.github.com/repos: 401 Unauthorized (token ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz)
out:      request failed: POST https://api.github.com/repos: 401 Unauthorized (token «github-token»)

case:     a credential quoted inside another quoted string
in:       msg="failed to authenticate with \\"ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\\""
out:      msg="failed to authenticate with \\"«github-token»\\""

case:     text in japanese around a credential
in:       トークンは ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz です
out:      トークンは «github-token» です

case:     a log line with nothing to redact
in:       time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" url=https://api.github.com/user status=200
out:      time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" url=https://api.github.com/user status=200

case:     a base64 blob that is not a token
in:       data=aGVsbG8gd29ybGQgdGhpcyBpcyBub3QgYSB0b2tlbiBhdCBhbGw
out:      data=aGVsbG8gd29ybGQgdGhpcyBpcyBub3QgYSB0b2tlbiBhdCBhbGw

case:     a uuid
in:       request_id=0123456789ab-cdef-0123-4567-89abcdef0123
out:      request_id=0123456789ab-cdef-0123-4567-89abcdef0123

case:     a hexadecimal digest
in:       sha256=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      sha256=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     a slack prefix whose every part is too short to be a secret
in:       SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-0123456789abcdef-0123456789abcdef
out:      SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-0123456789abcdef-0123456789abcdef

case:     an image tag whose digest stands against a slack prefix
in:       image: registry.example.com/xapp-8f14e45fceea167a5a36dedd4bea2543
out:      image: registry.example.com/xapp-8f14e45fceea167a5a36dedd4bea2543

case:     a branch name whose digest stands against a slack prefix
in:       branch xapp-4f3d2c1b0a9e8d7c6b5a49382716f5e4c3b2a190
out:      branch xapp-4f3d2c1b0a9e8d7c6b5a49382716f5e4c3b2a190

case:     a password is not one of the kinds this library knows
in:       password=0123456789abcdef
out:      password=0123456789abcdef

# More of the shapes a credential arrives in, and more of the kinds this
# library leaves alone.

case:     a github actions log line
in:       ##[group]Run gh auth login\n  GITHUB_TOKEN: ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef\n##[endgroup]
out:      ##[group]Run gh auth login\n  GITHUB_TOKEN: «github-token»\n##[endgroup]

case:     a kubernetes secret manifest
in:       apiVersion: v1\nkind: Secret\nstringData:\n  token: ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:      apiVersion: v1\nkind: Secret\nstringData:\n  token: «github-token»

case:     an nginx access log
in:       10.0.0.1 - - [17/Aug/2026:00:00:00 +0000] "GET /v1/user HTTP/1.1" 200 42 "-" "curl/8.0" "Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef"
out:      10.0.0.1 - - [17/Aug/2026:00:00:00 +0000] "GET /v1/user HTTP/1.1" 200 42 "-" "curl/8.0" "Bearer «jwt»"

case:     a docker compose fragment
in:       services:\n  app:\n    environment:\n      GITHUB_TOKEN: ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:      services:\n  app:\n    environment:\n      GITHUB_TOKEN: «github-token»

case:     a line of jsonl
in:       {"ts":"2026-08-17T00:00:00Z","msg":"authenticated","token":"github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW"}
out:      {"ts":"2026-08-17T00:00:00Z","msg":"authenticated","token":"«github-token»"}

case:     an http response with a set-cookie header
in:       HTTP/1.1 200 OK\nSet-Cookie: session=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef; HttpOnly; Secure\nContent-Length: 0
out:      HTTP/1.1 200 OK\nSet-Cookie: session=«jwt»; HttpOnly; Secure\nContent-Length: 0

case:     a shell heredoc
in:       cat <<EOF > .env\nGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\nEOF
out:      cat <<EOF > .env\nGITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»\nEOF

case:     a line of a makefile
in:       deploy:\n\tGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ./scripts/deploy.sh
out:      deploy:\n\tGITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token» ./scripts/deploy.sh

case:     a syslog line
in:       Aug 17 00:00:00 host app[1234]: authenticated with ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:      Aug 17 00:00:00 host app[1234]: authenticated with «github-token»

case:     a url encoded form body
in:       grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=ghr_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz&client_id=Iv1.0123456789abcdef
out:      grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=«github-token»&client_id=Iv1.0123456789abcdef

case:     an api key in the query string of a request
in:       curl "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?address=Tokyo&key=AIza0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"
out:      curl "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?address=Tokyo&key=«google-api-key»"

case:     an api key in a client side configuration object
in:       const firebaseConfig = { apiKey: "AIza0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy", authDomain: "example.firebaseapp.com" };
out:      const firebaseConfig = { apiKey: "«google-api-key»", authDomain: "example.firebaseapp.com" };

case:     text in japanese around a jwt
in:       アクセストークンは eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef です
out:      アクセストークンは «jwt» です

case:     a comment in source code
in:       // TODO: stop hard coding ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz here
out:      // TODO: stop hard coding «github-token» here

case:     a line of a ci job log
in:       $ aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::012345678901:role/deploy\n{"AccessKeyId":"ASIA0123456789ABCDEF","SecretAccessKey":"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"}
out:      $ aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::012345678901:role/deploy\n{"AccessKeyId":"«aws-access-key-id»","SecretAccessKey":"«aws-secret-access-key»"}

case:     a key opening sk- with none of the marker an openai key carries
in:       OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     a basic authorization header is not one of the kinds this library knows
in:       Authorization: Basic dXNlcjowMTIzNDU2Nzg5YWJjZGVm
out:      Authorization: Basic dXNlcjowMTIzNDU2Nzg5YWJjZGVm

case:     a github app client secret is not one of the kinds this library knows
in:       GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

# And a credential of a kind a pattern here does know, encoded on its way into
# the text. The scan reads the bytes it is handed and decodes nothing, so a
# token written into base64 shares no run of characters with the token itself
# and is not located: it comes through whole, and is a credential still to
# whoever decodes it. The case named "a basic authorization header is not one
# of the kinds this library knows" carries a password, no kind this library
# knows however it is written; the one below carries a classic token, which it
# does know, and is what states what the encoding costs.

case:     a classic token encoded into base64 is not located
in:       Authorization: Basic eC1hY2Nlc3MtdG9rZW46Z2hwXzAxMjM0NTY3ODlhYmNkZWZnaGlqa2xtbm9wcXJzdHV2d3h5eg==
out:      Authorization: Basic eC1hY2Nlc3MtdG9rZW46Z2hwXzAxMjM0NTY3ODlhYmNkZWZnaGlqa2xtbm9wcXJzdHV2d3h5eg==

# A leading byte order mark, a zero width space and a run of carriage returns
# for line endings — three things a file arrives with that are not any
# vendor's alphabet and stand in front of, or beside, a credential all the
# same. Mask redacts what is located and writes everything else back
# byte for byte, so none of these is special-cased.

case:     a file opening with a byte order mark
in:       ﻿GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:      ﻿GITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»

case:     a token pasted with a zero width space against it
in:       token=​ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz​
out:      token=​«github-token»​

case:     a token broken by a zero width space
in:       ghp_0123456789abcdef​ghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdef
out:      ghp_0123456789abcdef​ghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdef

case:     a log with carriage return line endings
in:       HOME=/root\rGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\rPATH=/usr/bin
out:      HOME=/root\rGITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»\rPATH=/usr/bin

# Text that has already been masked: a run of asterisks the length a real
# credential would leave, and the fixed placeholder a caller's own redactor
# or a CI system writes. Neither is in any built-in's alphabet, so masking
# such text again leaves it exactly as it was.

case:     a value already replaced with asterisks
in:       GITHUB_TOKEN=**************************************** AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=********************
out:      GITHUB_TOKEN=**************************************** AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=********************

case:     asterisks written against a live prefix
in:       ghp_************************************
out:      ghp_************************************

case:     text already redacted by another tool
in:       token=[REDACTED] jwt=[REDACTED]
out:      token=[REDACTED] jwt=[REDACTED]

# A single credential written at a size closer to what a caller's own key
# material reaches: a JWT with a payload of several kilobytes rather than the
# few dozen characters the rest of this file's values are. Escaped as one
# line here, as text_shapes.txt's own cases are, so every property driven
# over the corpus reaches a value this wide too.

case:     a jwt with a large payload
in:       Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdef
out:      Authorization: Bearer «jwt»
